build_commit_note: Test binaries embed parent 89b3e52939c1d9def2a08a2df18ec99a9cf4653f with source_dirty=true; source hash is the content identity, not a post-publication commit claim.

failures_and_corrections.failure: First runtime test required positive Roll after 0.6 seconds. ANGLE recovery legitimately commanded negative Roll.
failures_and_corrections.fix: Measure absolute rate on every flight tick, require reaching the selected limit and never exceeding it.

failures_and_corrections.failure: R1 existing real-profile storage integration could find the saved profile but could not activate its physical device; ok=false.
failures_and_corrections.status: Hardware integration remains pending; not waived as a pass. New-user package checks are a separate 13-check suite.

failures_and_corrections.failure: UE FileManager::Move pre-deletes destination, risking loss on a failed replacement.
failures_and_corrections.fix: Use Windows same-volume replace without pre-deletion; verify both successful overwrite and an actual sharing-lock failure preserves original bytes and live response.

failures_and_corrections.failure: One Shipping test started before r3 archive completed and was rejected for build mismatch.
failures_and_corrections.fix: Waited for packaging completion and repeated all relevant suites on matching r3 binary.

limits: No physical HID button learning, USB flight, cable loss or different physical PC verified.
Current WinMM backend: six axes, 32 buttons; not all USB devices.
AI difficulty/3-4 opponents, Topgun S course/records/online rooms are pending.
Other feedback items and CTL-13 full migration remain pending.
